claim: Proof-first structural Hash shape inference preserves deterministic semantic output, passes the fixed production latency and memory budgets, and stays within the existing 3% representative-workspace comparison gate after indexing hot-path optimization.

neutral_production_gate.decision: Passed every fixed production budget with deterministic semantic output.

representative_read_only_corpus.description: An anonymized two-project, read-only verification corpus. No corpus source was modified and no corpus-specific regression fixture was added.

excluded_cold_population_run.reason: This run populated the persistent cache and is not comparable to fully warm runs.

representative_read_only_corpus.comparison_limitation: The clean source revision predates other uncommitted inference work, so this is a whole-working-tree comparison rather than an isolated shape-only benchmark. The fixed production budgets are the authoritative release gate; this representative comparison is supporting evidence.
representative_read_only_corpus.decision: Accepted. Wall improves, CPU grows by 1.63%, RSS improves, retained engine heap grows by 0.93%, and every candidate growth measurement remains inside the 3% gate and fixed RSS ceiling.

allocation_evidence.description: DHAT run over a neutral structural-shape fixture using the exact final source and the mutually exclusive memory-profiling allocator.

root_causes: Nonlocal reads cloned every type fact in the file before selecting the latest matching fact.
Recursive expression inference repeatedly scanned all direct type facts by expression range.
changes: Use a borrowed file-local named-fact selector that preserves latest-position and ambiguity semantics without materializing unrelated facts.
Maintain a collector-local compact range-to-index map over the append-only direct fact vector; semantic ownership remains in the ordinary file facts.
invariants: The range index stores only indexes, never duplicate RubyType values or independent semantic truth.
Every indexed fact is validated as an expression subject at the exact indexed range.
Same-position ambiguity and active-right-hand-side exclusion remain fail-closed.
